cases.name: safety_overflow
cases.note: Design section 4.3 safety overflow. The code template (judgement + question + next check) is measured at 48 against the 120 budget; the four-item critical_limitations list is explicitly exempt, is never truncated, and is why the two numbers differ. The limitation list carries the payload, so counting it would push the system back toward the truncation the rule forbids.
